data.text:
**scale proof**
Airwallex.com states 200,000+ businesses, 287B+ payments processed annually, and $320M raised.
**problem mechanism**
No internal data mechanism evidenced on homepage; only customer pain from disconnected providers described — uncertain if internal.
**cost evidence**
No Airwallex own cost disclosed; only customer savings claims like $10k/month FX — uncertain, not Airwallex cost.
**counter-evidence**
AI-native infrastructure with SOC1/SOC2, PCI DSS, and public APIs/docs suggests mature data stack — uncertain for internal ops.
**wedge fit**
Weak fit without evidenced internal problem to solve free first — uncertain.
**verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no)**
no
**why**
No mechanism-or-cost evidence from Airwallex domain to support $3-6k/month payment — needs deeper research.
